project.description: Name of the project, or a folder to migrate (e.g. ./libs). Without it the whole workspace is migrated

fix.description: Whether overwrite icons prefixes or simply inform in console

customDataPath.description: JSON file with an icon mapping that replaces the built-in one, an array of { "replace": "<old>", "replaceWith": "<new>" }, resolved from the workspace root

replacementDataPath.description: Deprecated, use customDataPath. Resolved from the project root or the folder first
replacementDataPath.x-deprecated: Use --custom-data-path, resolved from the workspace root.
